      TRUST IS A TESTABLE CLAIM.

      Don't take our word for it.

      We hide a real chain's stores in one city and ask Twin Block to find them, using only the taste of the neighbourhoods around that chain in a different city. It never sees the brand or its stores. Then we reveal where the stores really are.

      1LearnFind the chain's stores in city A and the places its customers also love nearby (brand removed).
      2HideAll of the chain's stores in city B are held out. The signal never contains them.
      3PredictRank city B's map cells by Qloo taste. Take the top 5.
      4ScoreA hit is a pick within 1 km of a real store. Compare with busy areas, random and a plain LLM.
